title: Root Law of Root October 2025 candidate excerpts (unverified)

scope_strategy.name: M0 candidate: clearing movement, rule, and battle excerpts
notes: This is an unverified candidate package for T03 human review.
The scope covers only clearing movement and rule excerpts and does not claim complete turn legality.
Rule IDs are package-local design identifiers, not official source identifiers.

source_content:
Candidate transcription set for manual T03 review.
Target: Root Law of Root, October 2025.
Every excerpt below must be compared with the official source before verification.
2.1 Clearing: A clearing is a location on the map connected by paths.
2.2 Path: A path connects adjacent clearings for movement.
2.5 Rule: A faction rules a clearing if it has more warriors and buildings there than any other faction.
4.2 Move: A faction may move warriors from one clearing to an adjacent clearing.
4.2.1 Move restriction: A faction must rule the origin or destination clearing to move.
7.2.2 Lords of the Forest: The Eyrie Dynasties rule a clearing with their roosts as described by their faction rules.
